assets.description: IKEA official logo featuring the blue-and-yellow oval wordmark on a blue rectangular background. Clean, recognizable branding element suitable for banner headers, corner placements, or logo-lockup compositions. Maintains brand identity across all SÖDERHAMN campaign materials.

Warm, inviting atmosphere showcasing the sofa's versatility across living spaces. Ideal hero for lifestyle rotation campaigns emphasizing adaptable, vibrant design.
